title: Price Breakdown
text:
Cinematic automotive photography designed to showcase the vehicle, its details, and the personality behind it.


Basic — $125 - 30-minute shoot - 1 location - All raw photos - Digital delivery only
Standard — $175 - 1-hour shoot - 1–2 locations - All raw photos - Digital delivery only
Premium — $225 - 2-hour shoot - Multiple locations - All raw photos - Digital delivery only

title: About Iron Halo Visuals
text:
Iron Halo Visuals is a photography and visual storytelling brand focused on capturing people, machines, and lifestyles through a cinematic perspective.
The goal isn’t simply to take a photograph.
It’s to create an image that feels like a moment from a film.
